After about a month or 2 of using them the little piece of plastic surrounding the spring breaks off and goes flying then the clip is useless as the spring won't work anymore. For the price I wish they would reinforce that plastic piece with metal or something because it's the same exact break point with every single one (& i'm serious wh

reviews.t: I am very glad I was able to find this BIG clip on ...
reviews.x: This clip is strong, well-made, and holds my unruly hair quite securely.  I am very glad I was able to find this BIG clip on Amazon because there are zero in the stores.  Thank you!!

I have been looking for a sturdy hair clip to buy for my mother. She has long waist length hair and the hair clips that most stores carry today just do not last or hold your hair up for long. So I decided to spend a little more money and buy her this hair clip. My mother absolutely loves this hair clip. It holds her long hair and has not showed any signs of wear since she started wearing the clip. Time will tell if it continues to hold up but so far, she has been very pleased with the hair clip.

reviews.t: Great, huge clip for the value.
reviews.x: Indeed huge and clippy! I have a ton of hair—like waist-length, super thick coarse Asian hair (versus slippery shiny Asian hair)—and this holds everything. To maximize the clipping action I like to turn it after clipping so the spine faces to the side, not down the center—that way the teeth themselves get more gripping action. Turned to the side, it’s excellent for a casual French twist. Or just make a low poneytail and clip it up the center of your head, for the classic floppy piecey look.  My

reviews.t: Can hold long-ish hair in one bunch
reviews.x: My wife loves these hair clips.  We didn't read the length when we ordered them, and they're larger than the standard hair clip you get at the drugstore.  She says these are big enough to hold all her hair in a single bunch without having to fold it back on itself three times like with a normal clip, so it's easier, comfier, and dries much faster if she puts it up out of the shower.  The teeth are long enough to grip all her hair securely so it doesn't start falling out if she is moving around d

reviews.t: Long enough, but not nearly wide enough!
reviews.x: This clip is pretty, and of a good quality. Perhaps if you have long fine/thin hair, it will work well for you. I have long very thick hair and this clip doesn't even graze my scalp. It is not wide enough to hold all my hair in a twist. I have found cheaper, shorter clips at walmart that can handle it, although less elegantly than I would like. Disappointing.

reviews.t: Couldn't find a nice big clip like this in the stores
reviews.x: Couldn't find a nice big clip like this in the stores.  I thought it was a little pricey, but worth it once I got it.  Holds my thin hair.. and I think it would be good for thick hair too!
Great clip. Sturdy enough to hold my waist length hair in a bun.

I bought this in April, liked it a lot, used it almost daily and today, October, the little spring gave out. I don't consider 6 months a good longevity for something that costs this much, I expected a year or two of use, especially since it is French made and I thought that would be higher quality than Chinese.  Reading other reviews I guess I should have expected it. It is a lovely plastic tortoise shell look, and now I will go look for another that looks similar and hope for it being better ma

Love these extra large clips! They are the only thing that works throwing my thick head of hair up. Strong hold with this one as well! Their all not created equally as far as the strength and hold! That was my main worry with this. I would purchase again!
Lasted less than a year. Only used occasionally after showers for short periods of time. Very disappointing.
I have only worn it twice, however my hair is very thick and holds up well.
Purchased two - one for me and one for sister-in-law. We both Love them.

reviews.t: I found it to be stylish and of good quality. I would rate it 5 stars if ...
reviews.x: A member of the household bought this.  When I have moved it from my desk or my chair or my dresser to its correct storage location, I found it to be stylish and of good quality.  I would rate it 5 stars if it came with an elastic loop to attach it to some part of the wearer so that it does not get left around the house.

reviews.t: Starts out okay but soon loses its spring hold. ...
reviews.x: Starts out okay but soon loses its spring hold. It doesn't clasp all the way when it's not holding anything. When you're clipping your hair up you have to 'squeeze' it together for it to catch and hold. Because of this I have to redo it every few hours when it starts to fall.

Not a bad hair clip. Decent spring to hold my hair tight. My only criticism is that the ends of the teeth on the comb are a little sratchy/prickly against my scalp. Otherwise, it's a good clip for this price range.
Most clips don't stand up to my daughter's long, thick hair.  This clip is an exception.  She was thrilled with it especially since her go-to one of many years had just broken.
It's okay. More than I've ever paid for a clip. I dont like how it scratches my head when I clip my hair back. The color is nice. Size is great. But its uncomfortable to wear.
Perfect for holding long hair.  High quality.  Will definitely buy them again because they're so hard to find in any stores, especially quality jumbo clips

reviews.t: Does the job, even for thick long hair
reviews.x: I like the size of this clip for holding up thick hip length hair. It is just what i was looking for,and I'm very pleased with it.

reviews.t: It was good while it lasted
reviews.x: It broke on the 12th day. It was good while it lasted.  I should have listened to the other reviewers.
Soft plyable plastic, so it doesn't shatter if dropped. Holds long hair great!!
The pin holding the spring keeps backing out. Looks nice but cheaply made.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the clip for holding large amounts of thick or long hair securely.
A common complaint is that the clip breaks, often at the spring or the plastic around it, sometimes within a month or less.
Several reviewers note the clip is large and hard to find in stores, making it a valued purchase.
Some reviewers find the clip is not wide enough to hold very thick hair despite being long.
A few reviewers consider the clip sturdy and well-made.
